title: Off-day carousel: Free ChatGPT has ads now, three ways round them (7 cards, 4:5)
goal: Draw the seven 1080x1350 cards of the deck named below, each card's point as one picture of real size (at least 12% of the card), never type on plain ground. Card 1 is a full-bleed scene of one specific funny moment (a phone on a kitchen table showing a ChatGPT answer with a Sponsored card under it, the house felt robot beside it holding a price tag reading 0), headline at least 1.3 times the body cards' size, a different layout from the body cards in two of three ways. The experiment: a trade-off scale on every body card after the cover, what you give up against what you get, so each workaround reads in one glance. Card 7 is the palette's close: the takeaway, one picture, 'Subscribe free (makeyourmindup.ai)', the wordmark small bottom right.
contract: Outputs: .scratch/carousels/adsswitch/card-{1..7}.png (1080x1350) and .scratch/carousels/adsswitch/render.py. Colours, type and the mark only from the Brand section below and config/ve/brand-tokens.json; fonts from the repository's font files, never a system font. Body type at least 35 px of ink. No card numbers, footnotes, dates or URLs on the art other than the close's subscribe line. No real logo except ChatGPT's own where the card names ChatGPT, monochrome. Nothing outside the safe box; no empty band over 12%.
